name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-telemetry-store
description: Persists every polled telemetry read to an append-only CSV under the site's .mdk-data root, serves it back as time-ranged history for a dashboard graph, and reports real, currently-observed storage-transparency stats (mechanism, path, size, row count, growth rate) surfaced in sites.reveal's telemetryStorage field. See design/plugin-telemetry-store.md for the original CSV-vs-SQLite reasoning and the append-on-read design (Gateway plugins have no interval/boot hook -- see that doc's grounding, confirmed in maintainers/architecture.md).

200.description: Freshly pulled telemetry for every device, one CSV row appended per field.

routes.description: Pulls live telemetry (the same devices/fields dashboard.overview reports) and appends one row per field to the CSV store. This route's write only happens when something calls it -- Gateway plugins have no timer/boot hook of their own to drive this on a schedule (see plugin-telemetry-store.md's grounding) -- so src/supervisor.js's pollTelemetryStore() calls it as a fire-and-forget side effect piggybacked on the existing sites.overview/sites.reveal polling cadence. Not a bespoke timer, by design.

200.description: Oldest-to-newest samples, optionally filtered by device/field/time range, capped at 2000.

routes.description: Pure read: a time-ranged, optionally field-filtered slice of the CSV store, shaped for a dashboard <canvas>/line-chart consumer. No side effects.

200.description: Storage-transparency snapshot: mechanism, file path, size in bytes, row count, and a growth-rate estimate derived from real observed samples.

routes.description: Pure read, no side effects. This response shape is exactly SiteReveal.telemetryStorage (see openrpc/launch.openrpc.json) -- src/server.js's buildReveal() probes this route the same way it already probes /overview for SiteReveal.telemetry.
